hardware.campaign_rule: Qualify and report each architecture separately; do not transfer absolute rates or assume the same four-card connectivity.
hardware.required_allocation: exclusive GPUs with no competing compute processes
hardware.topology: observed device identities and directed physical port attachments

required_pre_capture_freeze: Content hashes of source, compiler, executable and device code objects
A runnable producer with explicit unpaced and monotone-ordinal paced modes
Instruction-width inspection for the scalar and vector variants
Observed physical topology and link-rate units for each selected card
Clock mappings, uncertainty bounds and instrumented-versus-uninstrumented controls
Exact cells, repetitions, thermal controls, physical floors, ceilings and mechanism-specific quantitative bands
Separate identification cells and unseen acceptance cells

stages.discriminates: Physical attachment and clock-domain assumptions before timing comparisons
required_observations: active link count and per-direction rate
clock offset and drift uncertainty before and after the batch
rejection_conditions: Unsupported peer access or transport substitution
No bounded mapping for timestamps used in a common phase

stages.discriminates: Producer instruction issue, intentional pacing and host launch work versus transport service

retained_historical_control.purpose: Retain original pacing and launch geometry as a diagnostic control; never call this unpaced or graph captured.

required_observations: Actual producer release and destination visibility
Unpaced producer has no clock-based busy wait
rejection_conditions: Treating access_width as compiled instruction evidence
Changing an address-pattern label changes an unpaced release schedule
Graph construction charged to device kernel service
A paced copy-engine tail is called unpaced service

stages.discriminates: Source memory reads, destination memory writes and cache reuse versus link traffic

working_set: rotating addresses larger than the observed last-level cache

required_observations: Payload bytes and available memory/link traffic counters
Separate source, link and receiver service floors
rejection_conditions: Calling warm-cache traffic a high-bandwidth-memory measurement
Using register-generated stores as an identical copy workload
Converting an undocumented raw counter directly to packet count

stages.discriminates: Receiver sharing, independent links and causal source release
required_observations: Common phase and each local visit
All source starts and receiver visibility terminals
Per-link traffic and actual shared attachments
Payload checksum plus a separate temporal-order observation when order is claimed
rejection_conditions: Maximum local duration substituted for a common phase
Assumed launch budget reported as observed skew
Missing clock uncertainty or arrival visibility semantics
Four-card evidence extrapolated to physical degree four or greater

stages.discriminates: Library protocol and registration costs above the directed packet path
required_observations: Selected algorithm, protocol and channel count
Matched directed-byte ledger and phase completion
rejection_conditions: A library algorithm change absorbed into a link-rate calibration

off_path: Retain the existing declared candidate and compatibility results exactly until a separately frozen, valid identification changes a named parameter.
